title: Karingani language
extract: Karingani is a Northwestern Iranian language and is a dialect of the Tati language of Iran. It is closely related to the Kalāsuri-Khoynarudi dialects and Harzandi and Kilit. It is spoken in East Azerbaijan Province, in the Dizmar district, Keringan, Kalasur and Khunirud villages.
